text:
Type: U-shaped sectional sofa with two chaises
Use: seating, lounging, family movie nights, stretching out; living room, family room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, solid birch wooden legs
Colors: off-white, very light cool grey, light natural wood
Shape: long low frame, chaise longue at each end, five loose back cushions, slim track arms, round tapered wooden legs, oversized and spread out
Feel: airy, relaxed, bright, generous
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, pale textiles, green plants; large Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: NORSBORG
product.description: Big or small, colourful or neutral. The sofa comes in many shapes, styles and sizes so that you can easily find the one that suits you and your family best.
